subject: mt-info
title: MT.INFO.------PR.TRS.
description: Chart on book p. 208 (WAC-6). MT-INFO (multi-information) is the subject; PR-TRS is the partner. From the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis) and INFO-COMP (information compression). From PROG-CONT: RT-ALGN (reality alignment). From RT-ALGN: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics), another CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis) and RE-ST (restructuralism). From INFO-COMP: AFN (affinity negation). From AFN: DIFF, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
